english.note: Use this formal phrase when an authority declares something unfit or unsuitable for further use.

exampleSentences.english: After inspection, the authority may condemn this machine as unfit for further use.
exampleSentences.traditional: 經檢查，當局判定不適用嘅就係呢部機。
